name: Forest Workshop
description: A portrait cozy workshop game in development. This 0.5 build completes workshop management: five facilities (three opened by one-time conditions) running on your rules or a counted queue, residents placed by their field for a passive speed bonus, opt-in auto-selling with a daily limit, invitations with tickets earned from daily deliveries (breakthroughs, tokens and a chosen-resident exchange), stock protection, upgrades and the 72-hour absence cap — on top of residents registered from your characters and personas, your own uploaded resident pictures stored as WebP, pairs between any two residents, and backups that carry the pictures; stories and letters follow. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → 숲결 공방.
